subgroup_flags.classification_notes: All patients had ARDS by Berlin definition (ards_only). Median BMI 28 kg/m2 (IQR 24–33), below the 30 kg/m2 threshold, and obesity was not an enrolment requirement (non_obese_population). Timing is known only relative to enrolment in a physiologic crossover study, so timing_subgroup is unclear per codebook ruling. ptp_target_subgroups: the PEEPPL strategy targets positive end-expiratory transpulmonary pressure via the Talmor sliding table (absolute_positive_end_expiratory_ptp); the comparator PEEPEIT strategy targets EIT Silent Spaces ≤15%, which is not a Ptp target (other). Mortality ranking: the only mortality reported is 'Survival rate 12/20 (60%)' with no stated timepoint; it is the longest reported mortality by default.

extraction_flags.overlap_evidence: No trial registration number is reported in this paper. COHORTS.md notes scaramuzzo_2020 and mauri_2024 share Italian investigators but differ in population (controlled ventilation versus pressure support) and period; this paper studies 20 paralyzed, controlled-ventilated ARDS patients in Ferrara and Milan with no stated enrolment window, and no other report in the candidate pool claims these patients. Concluded no overlap; cohort unique to this report.
unclear_items: population.age: text (Results, p. 1150) reports '61 years old (52–71 yr old)' but Table 1 reports 'Age (yr) 63 (53–72)'; Table 1 used as authoritative for tabular data, discrepancy flagged for adjudication.
outcomes: Table 2 text version on p. 1151 states SStot IQR '11.3% [9.6–13.8%]' while Table 2 (p. 1152) states '11.3 (9.6–13.4)'; Table 2 value used.

intervention.peep_titration_target: the numeric end-expiratory PL target range is not stated in this paper (it references the Talmor sliding table, reference 13); only 'slightly above zero' and end-inspiratory PL below 25 cm H2O are given, so end_expiratory_ptp_target_low/high left null.
feasibility.n_placement_attempted/n_placement_successful: inferred from 'all 20 enrolled patients were monitored'; the paper does not report placement attempts or failures explicitly.
design.enrolment_start/enrolment_end: not reported; ethics protocol numbers 171098 (Ferrara) and 625_2018 (Milan) suggest 2018 onward but no dates are stated.
mortality outcome 'Survival rate': timepoint of assessment not reported; recorded with timepoint.type not_reported.

extraction_flags.general_notes: Within-patient crossover physiologic study comparing esophageal-pressure-guided PEEP (PEEPPL, Talmor sliding table) against EIT Silent Spaces-guided PEEP (PEEPEIT) in the same 20 ARDS patients; order randomised by sealed envelope with 20-minute washout at clinical PEEP between trials. Spearman correlation between the two selected PEEP levels: Rs = 0.25; p = 0.29; Bland-Altman bias 0.2 cm H2O, LOA 12.0 to –11.6 cm H2O. Mechanical power correlated between steps (Rs = 0.78; p < 0.01). RCRATIO differed from 1 in the PEEPPL step (0.7 [0.64–1.07]; p = 0.009) but not the PEEPEIT step (0.93 [0.54–1.01]; p = 0.19); DfV vs hypothetical 50%: PEEPEIT 48.3% [34.9–52.4%], p = 0.11; PEEPPL 41.5% [39.1–51.6%], p = 0.005. Regional compliance ROI1–ROI4 rows of Table 2 and Table 3 not transcribed as separate outcomes (ROI1: 6.5 vs 7, p=0.18; ROI2: 10.8 vs 14.2, p=0.11; ROI3: 10.4 vs 11.8, p=0.28; ROI4: 5 vs 4, p=0.78) — no dedicated schema field for regional EIT compliance; recorded here. Minute ventilation row (7.7 vs 7.6 L/min, p=0.08) likewise not transcribed as a separate outcome. No adverse events or balloon-related complications reported anywhere in the paper (silence, not a negative statement).
